# Understanding and managing pod security admission {#understanding-and-managing-pod-security-admission}

You can configure pod security admission to enforce the Kubernetes pod security standards. You can apply this enforcement at both the global and namespace levels.

- [Pod security admission synchronization namespace exclusions](/openshift-docs-markdown/authentication/understanding-and-managing-pod-security-admission#security-context-constraints-psa-sync-exclusions_understanding-and-managing-pod-security-admission)
